register.labelZh: TRADE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: trade down 表示轉用較便宜或較基本的選擇;trade up 則表示轉用較好、較大或較昂貴的選擇。；店舖接受舊物作為購買另一件物品的部分付款時,可以使用 trade something in。；trade something off against something 可以表示改善一方面時,需要犧牲另一方面。；trade on 或 trade upon 可以表示某人利用名聲、關係、恐懼或信任取得好處。
register.summaryEn: Trade down describes changing to a cheaper or more basic option. Trade up describes changing to a better, larger or more expensive option. Trade something in is useful when a shop accepts an old item as part of the payment for another one. Trade something off against something helps you explain that improving one thing may require giving up part of another. Trade on or trade upon can show that somebody is using a name, relationship, fear or trust to gain something.
